description: ZebraSight zebra dichromat matrices. All RGB is LINEAR sRGB (decode before, encode after).
method: rgb_to_LS: Govardovskii et al. 2000 A1 templates x 'Typical CRT Brainard 1997' primaries scaled to sRGB luminance, quantum catch, von Kries to display white. LS_to_rgb: Vienot, Brettel & Mollon 1999 adapted to S/L: blue (0,0,1) and yellow (1,1,0) map to themselves. Night (< 0.02 cd/m2): grey = rgb_to_rod applied to all three channels.
